sections.title: One tree, many names
sections.text: The Great London Plane of Ely and Paul Wood’s Bishop’s Plane refer to the same individual. The research identity and original provenance remain intact; this folio creates no new tree.

sections.title: An encounter at the garden
sections.text: Ed visited on 11 October 2026 but could not reach the trunk. Documentary photographs remain separate from the Council illustration and are held for approved import.

sections.title: A tree being cared for
sections.text: The conservation project brings arborists and Cambridge engineers together to study and support the tree. Follow the credited source for the project’s research and photographs.

sections.title: Visiting with care
sections.text: Managed Old Palace garden. Confirm visiting arrangements with King’s Ely before travelling. Follow posted restrictions and staff instructions; do not cross barriers to reach the trunk. This record does not grant access. We could not reach the trunk on 11 October 2026.

noku.name: Nokuphila · the Ubuntu Tree
noku.identityNote: Existing public Atlas record: Unabantu Nokuphila. One Cape Town individual, remembered in Circle 234 and chosen for a planned Circle 237 appearance. Distinct from the Camp Unicorn fig.
noku.speciesNote: As recorded in the Atlas and Ian’s material; taxon reconciliation remains open.
noku.artworkCaption: A typographic portrait while permission-cleared photographs are prepared. No generated documentary image.
noku.lead: One living tree. A biography carried through guardianship, gathering and continuing relationship.

sections.title: A remembered companion
sections.text: Noku’s Circle 234 history is preserved. Ed has chosen her return for Circle 237; its wider constellation, question and Fire details remain undecided.

sections.title: The guardian’s account
sections.text: Ian’s material describes Noku as a gathering place and an ongoing relationship of care. This preview keeps his account separate from independently verified botanical and historical claims.

sections.title: A biography with room to grow
sections.text: Age, water lineage, naming traditions and ceremonial accounts need their own attribution and verification. They are not presented here as established facts. Guardian approval and image rights remain release gates.

sections.title: The tree and the proposal
sections.text: Noku is an existing Ancient Friend. Ubuntu Pod 0.1 is a separate co-design proposal; neither that room nor a digital-twin study is field evidence or a finished physical Pod.
